title: CSV fields with quotes and commas
prompt:
Importing customer files breaks on lines like `42,"Smith, John","He said ""hi"""`: `split_csv_line` in src/lib.rs
splits on every comma. Make it follow RFC 4180 for a single line: fields may be quoted, a quoted field may contain
commas, and `""` inside quotes is a literal quote. Unquoted fields are returned as they are. An unterminated quote
returns `Err(CsvError::UnterminatedQuote)`.
